title: game/items.json
description: The item kinds (I01): one row per item the player can hold. Code names a kind only for what it does (the bottle fills, the book opens, coins pay); every other item is a row here and nothing else. Loaded once into an IItemCatalogue by ItemCatalogue (Vocaterra.Game.Core). The other files name items by `name`.

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

items.description: The items in catalogue order. Names and ids are unique.

name.description: The item's stable key: saves and every data file name the item by it. Never renamed once released.

id.description: The item's stable number (the state digest and the code's ItemId enum use it). The ids below 100 are the first game's; a new item takes the next free id from 100, and an id is never reused.

stack.description: How many of the item one inventory slot holds.

icon.description: The atlas key of the item's picture (the hotbar, the held model). A key the atlas has no art for draws the fallback tile, and the content check reports it.

held.description: How the hand shows the item (default sprite: the icon extruded into voxels).

tags.description: What the item is, an open list of words (tool, food, material, container, currency). Rules ask for a tag, never for an id.

tool.description: Present when the item is a tool.

wear.description: The kind of slot the item is worn in (I03a): the `wear` of a slot of game/equipment.json (head, body, legs, feet, accessory, offhand, back). A worn item also carries a tag some slot group accepts, and its stack limit is 1.

stats.description: What the item adds to the player's stat sheet while it is worn (counted only in a group whose statsApply is true).

look.description: How the item looks on the body (I09 draws it; I03a only reads and checks it).

stats.description: Open stat keys (camelCase) to numbers, added to the key's sum: warmth is in tenths of a degree (I06); the others are the consumers' (I05a, I05b).

look.description: A colour (#rgb or #rrggbb) for each body part the item covers (head, body, legs, feet, sleeve...).

class.description: The material of the blocks the tool works on.

speed.description: How many times faster than bare hands the tool gathers that material.

yield.description: How many of a gather's drop the tool gives (default 1).
